title: Research Progress and Trends of Deep Learning in Stock Price Prediction: A Systematic Review from LSTM to Transformer
tldr: Systematic review of deep learning evolution from LSTM to Transformer for stock price prediction, analyzing architectures, performance, and future research directions.
problem_and_motivation: Stock price prediction faces challenges due to high volatility, non-linearity, and non-stationarity of financial markets. Traditional methods often fail to achieve accurate and stable results. There is a lack of systematic review focusing on evolution from LSTM to Transformer hybrid architectures with empirical comparisons.
approach: Conducted systematic review of deep learning models from RNN variants to Transformer architectures.
Analyzed characteristics, advantages, and limitations of LSTM, GRU, CNN, and Transformer models.
Compared empirical studies across datasets, evaluation metrics, and performance benchmarks.
Discussed challenges including data noise, overfitting, interpretability, and computational efficiency.
Proposed future research directions including multimodal fusion and real-time adaptive learning.
findings: num: LSTM achieves 0.46% daily return rate versus 0.32% for DNN and 0.26% for logistic regression.
num: LSTM Sharpe ratio reaches 2.34 compared to most control methods below 1.0.
num: Transformer reduces MAE by approximately 20.73% and MSE by 34.84% versus traditional models.
num: LSTM-Transformer hybrid reduces error metrics by over 50% compared to parent models.
num: Hybrid architecture achieves R² of 0.9618 versus LSTM 0.8430 and Transformer 0.7763.

topic_relevance.contribution_to_field: This paper provides a systematic review of deep learning evolution from LSTM to Transformer for stock price prediction. It analyzes characteristics, advantages, and limitations of mainstream models with empirical comparisons. The work identifies current challenges in data, model, and deployment levels. It proposes future research directions including multimodal fusion, interpretable AI, and real-time adaptive learning.
directly_justifies: LSTM achieves superior performance with 0.46% daily return rate and 2.34 Sharpe ratio.
Transformer demonstrates 20.73% MAE reduction compared to traditional models.
LSTM-Transformer hybrid achieves R² of 0.9618 with over 50% error reduction.
limits: Focused primarily on stock price prediction without coverage of other financial domains.
Empirical comparisons limited to specific datasets and time periods.
Does not provide original experimental validation of proposed architectures.
Computational cost analysis lacks quantitative benchmarks across models.
topic_relevance.topic_mapping_rationale: Systematic scan of all topic domains identified high relevance for predictive modeling (6.A) and forecasting algorithms (6.B) due to core focus on deep learning for financial prediction. Medium relevance for landscape of existing systems (4.A), ML model serving (14.B), and algorithmic evaluation (12.B) as supporting aspects. Domains related to Filipino demographics, budgeting strategies, anomaly detection, and mobile design were considered and rejected as not covered by this deep learning review paper.
